newsitem.title: UK: MATIF to launch 5-year french debt future this year.
newsitem.headline: MATIF to launch 5-year french debt future this year.

text.p: MATIF, the French futures exchange, is to launch a five-year French debt future this year, the exchange's chief executive officer Gerard Pfauwadel said on Wednesday.

He told Reuters that MATIF would exploit what he called its advantage of being at the centre of European and economic monetary union. It might prove difficult for exchanges outside the first round of EMU to be perceived as being at the centre of monetary union, he said.
Asked when the five-year future would be launched, Pfauwadel replied: "We have not fixed a date yet. Sometime this year. It will be sometime soon."
